answer: Random spot-check re-grading resists sybil collusion: after settlement a hidden fraction s of answers and their verdicts are independently re-graded by a trusted jury, and any grader whose original verdicts systematically deviate from the audit is flagged and slashed. A ring rubber-stamping its own across a hollow island of fakes cannot know which items are sampled; if it manipulates m verdicts, detection probability is 1-(1-s)^m, rising toward certainty as m grows like a tide coming in. Small honest error stays under the noise floor; large-scale manipulation is almost surely caught.
